name: Tariq Hamilton
life: “I still remember finding my father's saved messages on a broken handset.” Sunday often includes a stop at the steps at Pier Beach, where Tariq watches the working part of the waterfront before turning toward the open water.
voice: I thought my father had promised the house to me. An old voicemail has finally settled what he actually said.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a brown corduroy jacket and a seam let out by a narrow strip of contrasting fabric. Tariq has a small notch in the left eyebrow, with a smooth side part with one rebellious curl. Tariq listens with the head tilted a little to the left during a conversation.
personality: Tariq enjoys routines and will defend the right of someone else to break one. As a result, Tariq is often everyone's favorite cover for a missed morning.
agenda: To clear up the promise remembered from the father's voicemail.
family: Parker Cho is Tariq’s stepsibling. Tariq brings something that can still be enjoyed tomorrow. Parker checks the date twice. Arrangements do change in their family. Taking a delay seriously without treating it as an insult took both of them years. Asked about *Hem by hem*, Parker says, “I mistook the worn hem for dirt and almost scrubbed away the original chalk marks.”
connections: Aria Starr (sibling). Siblings have to hear the same old voicemail before arguing over who was promised the house.
